name: zotero-mcp
description: Chat with your Zotero library: search items, read metadata & full text, browse collections, and export BibTeX.
long_description: Node.js MCP server for the Zotero reference manager. Local mode (default) talks to the Zotero 7+ desktop app on this computer — enable Settings → Advanced → 'Allow other applications on this computer to communicate with Zotero'. Web API mode works with a Zotero API key + library ID instead. Runs entirely on Claude Desktop's built-in Node.js — no Python, no system dependencies. The 'unverified extension' dialog during installation is normal for self-distributed extensions; just approve it.

author.name: mubaroq - Akademi Digital Bandung | RPI Institute

use_local.title: Gunakan Zotero lokal (disarankan)
use_local.description: Terhubung ke aplikasi Zotero 7+ di komputer ini. Aktifkan dulu: Zotero → Settings → Advanced → 'Allow other applications on this computer to communicate with Zotero'.

api_key.title: Zotero Web API Key (opsional)
api_key.description: Hanya untuk mode Web API (bukan lokal). Buat di zotero.org/settings/keys

library_id.title: Zotero Library ID (opsional)
library_id.description: User ID Anda dari zotero.org/settings/keys. Hanya untuk mode Web API.
